configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Standard Linux build with all tests and examples. Use inside the ratos-dev-image container or when all dependencies (reflect-cpp) are installed locally.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Standard Linux build with full assertions and debug symbols.

configurePresets.name: evl
configurePresets.description: Build and test natively inside an EVL kernel guest. Requires reflect-cpp in the sysroot (present in ratos-dev-image and the RaTOS ISAR SDK). Run via scripts/evl-build.sh.

configurePresets.name: evl-cross
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile SeRTial tests against the RaTOS ISAR SDK sysroot. The SDK is downloaded and relocated automatically by scripts/evl-build.sh --cross. Verifies compilation works with the EVL target toolchain.
